operation_scope: One fixed OAuth token POST and one fixed read-only NRF discovery GET per benign block; matched passive block; preserve active UE
response_trigger: Explicit operator request using verified evidence; not an unvalidated model score
response_target: operator notification only; no UE, NF, subscriber or interface mutation
rollback_scope: Cancel notification delivery; no network state change to undo
held_out_result_policy: Do not inspect count deltas, feature distributions or scores until model and analysis choices are frozen
